name: shared-coverage
title: Shared coverage reservation
question: What changes if approvers declare amounts that sum to the coverage instead of each reserving all of it?
note: Today each approver reserves the FULL coverage, so a cohort of A approvers ties up A x coverage of budget until settleCoverage runs (ExposureLedger.sol:268). Under SHE-227 the cohort budget is the coverage itself, so the stake multiple stops scaling with cohort size and decentralising the guardian set stops taxing TVL capacity.
